notes.title: 🚨 Join the Police Shootout: Prologue Playtest! 🚨
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello Officers! 🤝[/h2][/b]
We are getting closer to the premiere of Police Shootout: Prologue and on this occasion, we decided to enable some of you to access the prologue earlier via [b]Playtest[/b]! 🚨

[h3][b] 👮‍♂️ WHAT ARE PLAYTEST?[/b][/h3]
The main goal of Playtest is to provide the developers with a way to test the game, from the best testers - PLAYERS! Thanks to this feature, developers can create a separate application containing the part of the game or the full game and the players can test it. Most importantly, the players have unique access to the game!

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Hello and Welcome!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi Everyone![/h2]

[b]Welcome on our first dev log![/b]
We know it's been a long time since first tailer released and so here we are. 
Our idea is to show you what's going on inside, what is in already development, mechanics, systems or maps. We are really open for community here, your questions and ideas. 

If you are here and reading this text you propably know what is the game about but if not in Police Shootout you will have that oportunity to be try yourself as a Police Officer in typical American City. 
Your job is to serve and help people during your everyday missions, but sometimes it's not that easy to make a fast choice who is the victim and who is the suspect, especially when time is running and so many things is happening around.
 
We did read most of (if not all) your comments here on steam and on the internet overall and as a developer I wanted to say that we are doing everything possible to make this game as good as possible. 

The development is in progress since few months so far and today we want to tease you with some map scenes on video below. In future updates we will show you some mechanics and decissions we made to make the Police Officer duty in the game satisfactory and complicated in the same time.

[previewyoutube=94xcdsz3s6c;full][/previewyoutube]

See you soon with next update!
